assertions.title: Task Graph Preview UI

steps.action: Open Task graph preview on Delegation page
steps.expected: Visual task graph with nodes/edges/confidence (and Approve button in approve mode)
steps.observed: UI consistently displayed 'This run does not include a decomposition plan'

steps.action: Switch selected runs to completed runs and reload/compare
steps.expected: At least one run displays planned task graph
steps.observed: No tested runs showed a decomposition graph

assertions.issues: Task graph visualization did not render for tested runs because no decomposition plan data was available in preview

assertions.title: Why-this-happened drawer

steps.action: Open run detail and click 'Why this happened'
steps.expected: Drawer shows structured decision records with goal/strategy/delegation/tool reasons/constraints/termination + timestamps

assertions.issues: Decision drawer UI exists but no structured decision records were available for the tested run

assertions.title: Run comparison view

assertions.issues: Comparison UI did not load decision data for selected completed runs
